profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Dedicated professional offering strong quick learning, critical thinking, problem solving and interpersonal skills. I am logical and adaptable with IT, hardware, mathematical and programming skills, including experience with the following programming languages: Java, C#, C++, Delphi, JavaScript, HTML, JQuery, SQL, and CSS.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Designed and implemented SaaS applications to improve physician productivity and hospital performance at the point of care.
● Provided design and architectural input, translating product requirements into scalable, documented solutions.
● Developed and maintained applications using C#, .NET, MVC, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS, and SQL Server.
● Built and optimized Web APIs and relational databases; wrote and tuned complex SQL queries and stored procedures.
● Collaborated with QA teams to establish testing best practices and ensure product quality.
● Mentored junior and intermediate developers, fostering knowledge growth and code quality across the team.
● Contributed to Agile Scrum ceremonies and process improvements, driving efficiency and cross-team collaboration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Performs product design, bug verification, release testing, and beta support on applications software projects which may require research and analysis. Design, code, test, develop and document application programs for moderately complex computer systems.

positions.description: Performs product design, bug verification, release testing, and beta support on applications software projects which may require research and analysis. Design, code, test, develop and document application programs for moderately complex computer systems.

positions.title: Intramural Coordinator
positions.description: Plan, organize, and monitor the completion of intramural sports seasons. Complete schedules; maintain stats and website for Intramural sports. Manage a staff of referees as well as continual communication with all participants.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: Educate students on various topics relating to the Mathematics and Computer Science fields. Provide students with study habits in order to ensure their academic success.
